propositions: The heal merges into the tracker's worktree HEAD, causing unrelated commits from a checked-out side branch to become reachable from the published tickets ref.
When the tracker's checked-out branch differs from the published ref, the heal must refuse before downloading or merging any bundles, raising S3DoctorConflict.
A detached-HEAD tracker must also be refused by the same guard to prevent pollution.
The refusal guard executes after the single-bundle no-op check, preserving existing behavior for stores with nothing to heal.
Remote bundles remain byte-identical to their original state when the heal refuses and no bundle is downloaded.
A tracker correctly on the published ref continues to heal losslessly with existing behavior unchanged.
